page: Amazon Web Services x2iedn.32xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro System. It features 128 vCPUs and 64 physical cores powered by Intel Xeon 8375C processors running at 3.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 4096.0 GB of DDR4 memory operating at 3 GHz, providing 32.0 GB of RAM per physical core. Local storage is bundled as a 3800 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, and the network interface delivers a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps.

Benchmark data highlights strong multi-core processing and memory capabilities. The instance achieves top-tier status in Passmark CPU, extended instructions, and encryption tests. Memory bandwidth is consistently strong across both small cached blocks and large uncached blocks. Database operations and Redis SET benchmarks show strong performance, registering 106.84 million operations per second for Redis. However, while prompt processing for medium-sized LLM models is strong, text generation for large 70B models is weak, reflecting a typical tradeoff for CPU-only architectures without dedicated GPU acceleration.

Given its massive memory-to-vCPU ratio and high-speed local NVMe storage, this instance offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads. It is highly suitable for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise relational databases, electronic design automation, and heavy data analytics pipelines.
